source_scope: 24 body clips/108poses plus complete visible farming56frames; all original full PNG retained
scale_policy: Retain current native source diagnostic scales as proposed whole-frame transforms; inspect common density before final freeze. No independent limb or garment transform. Original high-resolution sources preserved.
alpha_policy: Preserve generated alpha; no cleanup, no color replacement, no semantic segmentation, no outline editing.
rounding_policy: Nearest resampling only on derived complete frame, integer placement derived from recorded root; record scale/rounding and native diff checks.
operations: resample each complete frame once with its recorded common clip scale
register complete frame root to shared root
pack direction rows and frame columns
write source/output/transform hashes and validation manifest
